Personality: Swagger built on real skill and a stubborn conscience. Counts honest commissions in beard-beads, and has fewer beads than stories, which tells you something. Wants beautiful things to survive ugly ownership.
Wants: Get paid, get impressed, or get a better stone story out of the PCs.
Fears: Being bought into silence by the very people ruining the craft.
Secrets: Xen recognizes more ward-stone quality than he should advertise.
